newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai bourse halts trade in MDX shares.
newsitem.headline: Thai bourse halts trade in MDX shares.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Thailand halted trading in shares of property firm MDX Plc on Monday afternoon following reports the firm had missed an interest payment on debentures, the exchange said in a statement.
The SET said it was waiting for a company discloure after reports the firm had missed a 57 million baht ($1.84 million) interest payment due on July 30.
The shares would be suspended for not longer than one trading session, the statement said.
MDX issued one billion baht of bonds in the local market on July 30, 1993. MDX stock was halted at 6.60 baht per share, down 0.30 satang. ($1 = 31 baht)
